SPECIFICRULES.PREVIOUSANCESTRY: Which ancestry did you have before becoming a vampire?

FORMERANCESTRYMODE.NAME: Former Ancestry: Use expanded sync
FORMERANCESTRYMODE.HINT: Applies the selected former ancestry's chassis details to Vampire characters.

FORMERANCESTRYSOURCE.NAME: Former Ancestry: Available sources
FORMERANCESTRYSOURCE.HINT: Limits new former ancestry selections to the PF2e Ancestries compendium or allows ancestries from every compendium pack.

HUNGERMETER.NAME: Hunger Meter: Show character sheet panel
HUNGERMETER.HINT: Displays the Hunger meter on Vampire character sheets.

HUNGERCONDITIONS.NAME: Hunger: Automate conditions
HUNGERCONDITIONS.HINT: Automatically applies and removes hunger-linked drained, confused, and dying conditions for vampire player characters.

HUNGERRESTINCREASE.NAME: Hunger: Increase on rest
HUNGERRESTINCREASE.HINT: When enabled, vampire player characters gain 1 hunger whenever Rest for the Night is used.

DRAINED.NAME: Hunger Thresholds: Drained
DRAINED.HINT: Hunger value at which vampire characters begin gaining drained.

CONFUSED.NAME: Hunger Thresholds: Confused
CONFUSED.HINT: Hunger value at which vampire characters begin gaining confused.

DEATH.NAME: Hunger Thresholds: Dying
DEATH.HINT: Hunger value at which vampire characters begin gaining dying.
